mcp:tool-listener.name: get-alert
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Returns a transaction-monitoring alert together with the account and the customer profile (occupation, employer, declared annual income, stated purpose of the account, risk rating, customer since). alertId looks like ALT-0915; "0915" is accepted too. Returns {"found": false} when there is no such alert.

set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 var id = upper(trim(payload.alertId default '')) --- if (id startsWith 'ALT-') id else 'ALT-' ++ id]

db:select.db:sql: SELECT a.alert_id, a.raised_on, a.rule, a.detail, a.status, ac.account_id, ac.branch, ac.type AS account_type, ac.opened_on, c.customer_id, c.name, c.name_kana, c.birth_date, c.address, c.occupation, c.employer, c.declared_income, c.purpose, c.risk_rating, c.customer_since FROM alert a JOIN account ac ON ac.account_id = a.account_id JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = ac.customer_id WHERE a.alert_id = :id

mcp:tool-listener.name: list-transactions
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Lists the transactions of an account, oldest first: date, kind (振込入金 / 現金入金 / 振込出金 / 海外送金 / 口座振替), amount in JPY, counterparty and channel (ATM location or branch).

db:select.db:sql: SELECT txn_date, kind, amount, counterparty, channel, memo FROM txn WHERE account_id = :id ORDER BY txn_date, id

mcp:tool-listener.name: get-case
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Returns the investigation state kept for a conversation (contextId): which alert it is about, its step ("awaiting_decision" after the draft memo was shown, "decided" once the analyst decided) and the recommendation. Returns {"found": false, "step": "new"} for a conversation that has none.

mcp:tool-listener.name: save-case
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Saves the investigation state for a conversation after the draft memo is prepared. step is "awaiting_decision"; recommendation is one of "close", "file_str" or "hold".

db:insert.db:sql: INSERT OR REPLACE INTO aml_case (context_id, alert_id, step, recommendation, updated_at) VALUES (:ctx, :alert, :step, :rec, datetime('now'))

mcp:tool-listener.name: record-decision
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Records the analyst's decision on the alert of this conversation and closes the case. decision is "close" (no further action), "file_str" (escalate for a suspicious transaction report) or "hold" (keep open pending more information). Returns the decision ID.

db:update.db:sql: UPDATE aml_case SET step = 'decided', decision = :decision, note = :note, decision_id = :did, updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE context_id = :ctx
UPDATE alert SET status = :status WHERE alert_id = (SELECT alert_id FROM aml_case WHERE context_id = :ctx)
